---
applyTo: "**"
---

Follow AGENTS.md as the repository source of truth.

Required behavior:
- Keep package imports and naming under @repo/*.
- Do not introduce deprecated patterns or outdated APIs.
- Prefer installed versions and official docs over model memory.
- Use Biome for formatting/linting and Turborepo for task orchestration.
- Validate with format, lint, check, and build from repository root when relevant.
